label: +0.3 cm (Both Sides)
description: A 3mm pad gives a gentle but visible lift to the shoulder line, creating a slightly cleaner horizontal projection without introducing any of the hard angularity of traditional British construction. This is the natural resting point for most bespoke clients: enough structure to project confidence and give the jacket a tailored rather than casual identity, but soft enough that the shoulder curves gently into the sleeve with no visible ridge. It pairs equally well with a natural rolled sleevehead or a more polished set sleeve, and is the standard padding weight across most Milanese and Roman tailoring houses.
